decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The external walls of the rear extension and outbuilding hereby permitted shall be faced in red brickwork matching that of the original house, with doors and windows to match those of the existing house.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding and extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 13 The Green and shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate dwelling, nor shall they be used for business purposes.
Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension following demolition of existing garage and erection of new detached outbuilding in rear garden.
